command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes' -Method Get; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$d=Compare-Object `$b `$a | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notlike '!Last configuration*' -and `$_.InputObject -notlike '!Last *' -and `$_.InputObject -notmatch '^20[0-9][0-9]-' }; if(`$d){ Write-Output `$n.node_id; `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } }"
